# Security Policy

## Supported version

The latest commit on `main` is the only supported version.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue or pull request for a suspected vulnerability.
Report it privately through [GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/noa4021J/noa4021J.github.io/security/advisories/new).

Include the affected page or component, reproduction steps, impact, and any suggested mitigation. Acknowledgement and remediation timing depend on severity and reproducibility.
